name: ColorCodex Color Lookup Agent
description: A read-only agent that retrieves HTML/CSS named color codes (hex, RGB, HSL) and converts hex values to RGB and HSL. No authentication required.

skills.name: Lookup Color
skills.description: Retrieve an HTML/CSS named color by name. Returns hex, RGB and HSL codes.
examples: What is the hex code for salmon?

skills.name: Convert Color
skills.description: Convert a hex color string to RGB and HSL representations. Accepts 3 or 6 hex digits, with or without a leading #.
